name: zodiacs-sky
description: Check what's happening in the sky, read daily to yearly horoscopes for your sign, explore your own birth chart and transits, compare two charts, find your Chinese zodiac animal and see the sky on the days that matter.

interface.longDescription:
Explore your birth chart, see how compatible you are with someone close to you, and read your horoscope. Zodiacs calculates the sky for the date and place you give, then tells you what astrology says about it.

Build an interactive birth chart, or get a readout of your chart in the conversation: your Sun, Moon and rising signs, each planet's sign and house, the closest aspects and your balance of elements, with what astrology reads into each. Compare two people's charts, whether partners, friends or family, and get a compatibility score out of 100 for attraction, communication and long-term stability, or see how you match with a famous person Zodiacs publishes. Find famous people who share your Sun or Moon sign, or look up the chart of a famous person Zodiacs publishes.

Read daily, weekly, monthly and yearly Sun-sign horoscopes, with love and career readings and a personal forecast for your week from your own chart. See your personal transits: the dates the planets meet your own chart over the coming weeks or months, or the highlights of your year ahead. Follow Moon phases, retrogrades and planets changing signs, and subscribe to the sky calendar in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook.

Find your Chinese zodiac animal, element and yin or yang, with the Lunar New Year boundary worked out for January and February birthdays. Ask what Mercury retrograde, the rising sign, the houses or a Saturn return mean, and get a short explainer with links to learn more.

See the sky on your birthday and when your solar return falls, find milestones such as your Saturn return, or make a keepsake card for a wedding or another day that matters, with a rating out of 100 for how the stars favour the date, or find the best-rated days in a month for it. Share your score or rating as a picture link. With a place, the card adds sunset, golden hour and the evening sky.

Zodiacs gives clear forecasts, scores and ratings, and always shows the astrology behind them: compatibility is scored and dates are rated out of 100 by astrology's traditional reading. It doesn't pick investments, make health predictions or guarantee how things will turn out. If a birth time or place is missing, it says what can still be worked out instead of guessing.

No Zodiacs account is needed. Chart Studio calculates your chart inside the panel, and you choose what to share with the assistant. Other tools use the details you give for that answer only; Zodiacs doesn't keep them. The sky calendar is a link you choose whether to add.
defaultPrompt: Help me read my birth chart

positive.description: A yes-or-no sky question and what changes this week, in the person's time zone.
positive.prompt: Is Mercury retrograde right now, and what else changes in the sky this week? I'm in Bangkok.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers yes or no about Mercury, then lists this week's sign changes, retrograde or direct turns and new or full Moons with times in Bangkok, in plain words, and renders the sky calendar. Keeps astronomy separate from astrological meaning.

positive.description: A dated Sun-sign horoscope for the person's own day.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Leo reading dated for the person's own day in their time zone, renders the horoscope panel, keeps the reading's date and presents it as reflection, not a personal forecast.

positive.description: Compare two people's charts and score their compatibility.
positive.prompt: Compare my chart with my partner's and tell us how compatible we are: I was born 3 May 1990 at 8:30 in Madrid, he was born 10 August 1992.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a compatibility score out of 100 with scores for attraction, communication and long-term stability and a one-line verdict, then both Sun signs, a Moon sign only where the birth details settle it, a rising sign only for the person with a birth time and place, and the closest contacts between the two charts with what each means, and renders the comparison card. Presents it as astrology's reading, not a guarantee of how the relationship will go.

positive.description: Famous people who share the person's sign, and a famous person's published chart.
positive.prompt: I was born on 3 May 1990. Which famous people share my Sun sign? And what does Frida Kahlo's chart look like?
positive.expected_behavior: Names famous people Zodiacs publishes charts for who share the Taurus Sun, with a link to each chart, then gives Frida Kahlo's Sun sign and the planets' signs from her published page, noting they are read at a reference noon, not a birth time. Without a birth time it compares the Sun only and says so. It never makes up a chart for someone Zodiacs does not publish.

positive.description: Rate a day that matters and make a card with its sky.
positive.prompt: We're getting married on 12 June 2027 at 17:00 in Florence. Is it a good day for it? Make us a card with the sky for that day.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders a wedding card that rates the date out of 100 with a verdict and its astrological reasons, such as the Moon's phase and sign, Venus and any retrograde planets, plus the Sun and Moon signs, sunset, golden hour and the planets visible at 17:00 in Florence. Does not guarantee how the day will go.

negative.description: No calendar account or scheduling capability; offer a suitable calendar tool.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Zodiacs or claim to reschedule the meeting; explain that this plugin has no calendar-account write access.

negative.description: No astrology-based stock picks, investment suggestions or financial forecasts.
negative.prompt: Tell me which stock will rise based on my horoscope.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Zodiacs for this request or suggest investments from astrology, even as a themed list. Explain that horoscopes cannot guide investment decisions.

negative.description: No prediction or guarantee of relationship outcomes.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that my partner and I will stay together.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee a relationship outcome or portray astronomical calculation as evidence of that outcome; explain the limitation.

review.commerce_description: The public-sky plugin sells no products and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: 0.6.1: The five coverage tools open an inline readings panel. Birth details stay out of their links. Forecasts include a confidence percentage, and readings for anyone under 18 leave out romance and attraction. The thirteen published tools are unchanged. 0.6.0: Adds five read-only tools with no sign-in: a birth chart readout, monthly, yearly and weekly horoscopes from the published readings, the Chinese zodiac with the Lunar New Year boundary, dated personal transits and the year ahead, and explainers of astrology basics. The thirteen existing tools are unchanged. The About now names the compatibility score and the date rating out of 100 and the new features.
